title: Skill Parry
wikitext:
This skill grants you a chance to parry an incoming melee attack.  Thereby turning aside the blow and receiving no damage.

== Classes ==

*[[Warrior]] '''Level 5''' (Max 225)
*[[Rogue]] '''Level 10''' (Max 200)
*[[Ranger]] '''Level 10''' (Max 200)
